content.text: Do I need to know Git or coding?
Basic copy/paste helps, but you only need to edit the data.json file. A video tutorial is available showing exactly where to paste your text and images.
Can I host this on my university server?
Yes. Since it's just HTML/CSS/JS, you can zip the folder and upload it to any university web hosting service.
Can you set me up for it?
Yes, I'd love to help! Send a message and I'll check my availability. I do this for free, though donations are welcome.
Is this as good as a custom-coded website?
For 80% of scholars — yes. For advanced features you'd need a developer, but AVI templates are specifically designed for academic use cases.
